observations: Both complete foods were independently acquired, identity-checked, hashed, and passed through the same five-organ boundary.
The foods are strongly orthogonal in domain and differ greatly in size; MUTHER chunk count changed from 15 to 148 and content fingerprints changed.

Downstream envelope counts remained exactly 80 nutrients, 11 waste items, VAJRA depth 8, 10 SHROOMING agents, and 12 recombinations. These invariant counts are treated as pipeline/scaffold behavior, not evidence of learning or transfer.
No retained candidate machinery from the first meal has yet been causally shown to alter routing or behavior on the held-out meal.
Stable admission remains forbidden. Delayed retest remains required.

failureHistory.heldout-concrete-sulfate-2024: Acquisition failed in CI twice through the MDPI source boundary; preserved as a source/acquisition failure rather than reclassified as digestion success. The orthogonal probe was rerouted to RFC 9110 rather than weakening identity verification.

decision.reason: Cross-food execution succeeded, but transfer has not been demonstrated. Identical envelope counts across very different foods suggest current fixed scaffold constraints rather than retained adaptive behavior.
next: measure routing/content-level deltas rather than fixed envelope counts
test whether any first-meal candidate changes held-out decisions under an ablation/control comparison
perform delayed retest in a later run before any incorporation
